description.value: Hen Long Market is a Surrey institution operating since 1984, specializing in Southeast Asian groceries directly imported from Vietnam, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, and Hawaii. Beyond retail, it serves as a wholesaler to local businesses and chain supermarkets across Western Canada, reflecting its deep roots in the regional food supply chain. The market anchors a multi-floor plaza with allied health offices and other services on upper levels.
